description: MON01 became unresponsive after the initial reboot; VirtualBox log reported lost heartbeat. Live snapshot failed with VERR_VM_UNEXPECTED_UNSTABLE_STATE and SUSPENDED_LS. ACPI/reset/poweroff did not finish. The identified MON01 GUI process was stopped and the VM started headless from its current VDI. No snapshot restore, disk deletion or engine edit was performed.
